title: Calculate a Moving Average
learning_objective: Learn how a fixed-size window frame calculates rolling metrics.

tutorial.explanation: A 3-day moving average uses the current row plus the two previous rows. A 7-day average uses the current row plus six previous rows.
tutorial.syntax: AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
tutorial.mental_model: The frame is a sliding window. It moves one row at a time and recalculates over the rows inside the window.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT visited_on, ROUND(AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_average FROM daily_amounts;
guided_example.explanation: The frame contains up to three rows: two previous days plus the current day.

practice.expected_query: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum FROM daily_amounts;

hints: Use ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
